tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Free. Is a listed service up right now? Its state (up, degraded, down, or unknown when not checked yet), since when, the latest check, uptime over 24 hours, 7 and 30 days, and recent outages, from ToolVet's own checks.

tools.name: search_services

Returns listings ranked by relevance, trust score and usage, each with price, live status and how to call it; sponsored listings come in a separate list. tools.name: recommend_service
tools.description: Get the best 3 live, trustworthy services for a task, with reasons and call instructions. Use it when you have one concrete task; use search_services to compare more options. Costs $0.01 via x402.

tools.name: get_service_report
tools.description: Full vetting report for one service (uptime, latency, price history, security findings). Takes an id from search or recommend results. Costs $0.002 via x402.

tools.name: preflight_check
tools.description: Live-check an x402 URL before paying it: valid challenge, real price, token, pay-to match. Sends one unpaid request to the URL and compares the answer with our records; the verdict is ok, caution or avoid. Costs $0.005 via x402.
